title: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 - label checks used by PackSure
notes: Built from the consolidated text 'as amended up to 13 February 2026' (Khaitan & Co. reading copy). Page numbers refer to that PDF.
Requirements are paraphrased for the checker. The source text is the authority; cite the notification in 'basis', not the reading copy.
The Second Amendment Rules 2026 (in force 1 Jul 2027) and Third Amendment Rules 2026 (Rules 4 and 27) do not change any check below.
Food packages: name/address of manufacturer (6(1)(a)) and date of manufacture (6(1)(d)) fall under FSSAI rules instead. PackSure flags these as 'verify' for food rather than 'fail'.

check_types.presence: a declaration of this kind must be found on the label
check_types.pattern: the declaration must also match a required form (units, wording)
check_types.measurement: a physical size measured from the photo with the reference marker
check_types.manual: needs the inspector's judgement; PackSure only prompts

declarations.title: Name and complete address of manufacturer / packer / importer
declarations.requirement: Name and complete address (street, city, state and PIN code) of the manufacturer; if the packer differs, both; for imported packages, the importer. Bare company name and address is presumed to be the manufacturer.
declarations.pattern_hint: 6-digit PIN code present in the address block

overrides.reason: Rule 6(1)(a) Explanation III: FSS Act 2006 and its rules apply instead.
Proviso to 6(1)(a): name on the package; address may be via QR code if the pack says so.

declarations.basis: G.S.R. 629(E) dated 23-06-2017 (complete-address explanation); proviso by G.S.R. 456(E) dated 23-06-2023

declarations.title: Country of origin, manufacture or assembly (imported products)
declarations.requirement: Imported products must name the country of origin, manufacture or assembly. If made abroad and packed in India, the Indian packer or importer's name and complete address must be on the principal display panel.

declarations.title: Common or generic name of the commodity
declarations.requirement: The common or generic name of the commodity; for multi-product packs, the name and number or quantity of each product.

declarations.title: Net quantity in standard units
declarations.requirement: Net quantity in SI units (g below 1 kg, kg at or above; ml below 1 L, L at or above; cm below 1 m, m at or above) or by number. No 'dozen', 'gross' or similar. No words that exaggerate or mislead about quantity. Multi-packs state number x quantity of each (e.g. 10 x 10 g).

declarations.title: Month and year of manufacture
declarations.requirement: The month and year in which the commodity was manufactured, in words, numerals or both.

overrides.reason: Proviso: FSS Act 2006 and its rules apply.
Proviso: Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, 1945 apply.

declarations.basis: 'or pre-packed or imported' omitted by G.S.R. 779(E) dated 02-11-2021 w.e.f. 01-10-2022

declarations.title: Best before / use by date
declarations.requirement: If the commodity may become unfit for human consumption after a period, 'best before' or 'use by' date, month and year, unless another law provides for it.

declarations.title: Maximum retail price inclusive of all taxes, in Indian currency
declarations.requirement: Retail sale price shown as the maximum retail price inclusive of all taxes, in Indian currency. A lower-MRP sticker may be added but must not cover the original MRP (6(3)).
declarations.pattern_hint: price with Rs/₹ and the phrase 'inclusive of all taxes' (or 'incl. of all taxes')

overrides.reason: First proviso: State Excise laws apply.

declarations.basis: G.S.R. 629(E) 2017 (inclusive of all taxes); 'in Indian currency' by G.S.R. 779(E) dated 02-11-2021 w.e.f. 01-10-2022

declarations.title: Dimensions where size is relevant
declarations.requirement: Where size matters (e.g. bed-sheets, towels, sarees), the dimensions of each piece; and the number of pieces.

declarations.title: Consumer care: name, address, telephone and e-mail
declarations.requirement: Name, address, telephone number and e-mail address of the person or office to contact for consumer complaints. E-mail is mandatory, not optional.
declarations.pattern_hint: both a phone number and an e-mail address
declarations.basis: Substituted by G.S.R. 385(E) dated 14-05-2015 w.e.f. 01-01-2016 ('if available' removed)

declarations.title: Unit sale price
declarations.requirement: Unit sale price in rupees to two decimals: per gram if under 1 kg, per kg above; per ml / per litre; per cm / per metre; per number or unit. Not required where retail price equals unit sale price.
declarations.pattern_hint: Rs/₹ amount with two decimals followed by 'per <unit>'

declarations.title: 'GM' at top of panel for genetically modified food
declarations.requirement: Every package of genetically modified food bears 'GM' at the top of its principal display panel.

declarations.title: Green / red-brown dot on cosmetics and toiletries
declarations.requirement: Soap, shampoo, toothpaste and other cosmetics and toiletries show a green dot (vegetarian origin) or red/brown dot (non-vegetarian origin) at the top of the principal display panel.

presentation.title: Minimum height of numerals and letters
presentation.requirement: Every numeral and letter in the mandatory declarations must be at least the height in Table I for the principal display panel area.
presentation.boundaries: Area A: row 1 is A <= 50; row 2 is 50 < A <= 100; row 3 is 100 < A <= 500; row 4 is 500 < A <= 2500; row 5 is A > 2500.

overrides.reason: Proviso: Medical Devices Rules 2017 apply (Amendment Rules 2025, w.e.f. 24-10-2025).

presentation.basis: Rule 7(2) and Table I substituted by G.S.R. 629(E) dated 23-06-2017 w.e.f. 01-01-2018

presentation.title: Minimum width of letters and numerals
presentation.requirement: Width of a letter or numeral at least one third of its height, except '1', 'i', 'I' and 'l'.

presentation.title: How the principal display panel area is computed
presentation.requirement: Excluding top, bottom, can flanges, bottle shoulders and necks: rectangular side = height x width; cylindrical = 40% of height x circumference; other shapes = 40% of total surface or the area considered to be the panel.

presentation.title: When another law also prescribes the label
presentation.requirement: If another law also requires this information, Rule 7(1)-(4) do not apply EXCEPT the size of numbers and letters for net quantity, retail sale price, expiry / best before / use by date and consumer care details.

presentation.title: Declarations on the principal display panel; clear space around quantity
presentation.requirement: Every declaration appears on the principal display panel. Around the net quantity: clear space above and below at least the numeral height, and left and right at least twice the numeral height.

overrides.reason: Amendment Rules 2025: Medical Devices Rules 2017 govern placement.

presentation.title: Legible, contrasting, in Hindi or English
presentation.requirement: Declarations legible and prominent; MRP and net quantity numerals in a colour that contrasts with the background (not required if blown/moulded on glass or plastic); not readable only through liquid; in Hindi (Devanagari) or English, other languages allowed in addition.

presentation.title: No stickers to alter mandatory declarations
presentation.requirement: Stickers may not be used to alter or make mandatory declarations, except a lower-MRP sticker that does not hide the original MRP, and labels on imported packages.

scope.title: Packages of 10 g / 10 ml or less are exempt
scope.requirement: The rules do not apply to packages of net weight or measure 10 g or 10 ml or less, EXCEPT tobacco products and (from 1 Feb 2026) pan masala.

scope.title: Other exempt packages
scope.requirement: Fast food packed by restaurants/hotels; drugs under the Drugs (Price Control) Order 2013 (medical devices declared as drugs are not exempt); thread in coil for handloom weavers; loose garments/hosiery the buyer can inspect (but they must still show maker, consumer care, size and MRP).

scope.title: E-commerce listings
scope.requirement: E-commerce entities display all 6(1) declarations except month/year of manufacture. From 1 Jul 2026, imported products must be filterable by country of origin.
